{{Top}}
A '''stasis chamber''' was used to preserve living beings in [[Suspended animation/Legends|suspended animation]]. During the early stages of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was placed in a stasis chamber on [[Palpatine's Sith Infiltrator|his personal Sith Infiltrator]] so he could recover from [[Aorth-6]] [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]] he received from a [[Ghost Prison incident|coup]] at the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]]. This was a special chamber that the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Jaden Korr]], the [[Iteration]] was kept in hibernation, when not needed by the [[One Sith]].
